justification: Replaces external API call with local DB query and parallelises independent calls. No schema changes. 3 files changed.

pre_impl.existing_data: development_applications table — 50K+ rows with latitude/longitude columns
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If DA table is empty or lat/lon NULL, fetch_nearby_das returns empty list — same as before when API returned no results
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reads existing rows only. No writes.

functions.name: fetch_nearby_das
functions.input: conn (psycopg2 connection) + lat/lng floats + optional council_name str + radius_m/days/limit ints
functions.output: list[dict] — each dict has keys: number, address, description, status, lodged (ISO str), distance_m (int)
functions.if_none: Returns empty list. DA section omitted from report.

functions.name: _fetch_db_data
functions.input: Captures req (with lat/lng/address), controls dict, council_name str, dcp_former_council str, lot_wkt geometry from enclosing scope
functions.output: Tuple of (das: list[dict], lep_clauses: list, dcp_setbacks_db: dict or None, postgis_heritage: dict with hca/items/has_heritage/raw keys)
functions.if_none: Returns defaults (empty list/dict). Report generates without DA/heritage/setback sections.

functions.name: _fetch_shadow
functions.input: Captures resolved_prop_id, controls, req from closure
functions.output: Optional[dict] shadow result with height/bearing/risk keys, or None if no prop_id
functions.if_none: Returns None. Shadow section omitted from report.

values.guard_at: conveyancing_db.py:637 — if da_lat is None or da_lng is None: continue
conveyancing_db.py:642 — if dev_type: guard + isinstance checks + json.loads fallback

queries.purpose: Fetch DAs within bounding box of target lat/lng, filtered by date
queries.where_clause: latitude BETWEEN %s AND %s AND longitude BETWEEN %s AND %s AND (lodgement_date >= %s OR determination_date >= %s) [AND council_name = %s]
queries.if_zero: Returns empty list — DA section omitted from report
queries.if_wrong: Overly broad bbox returns extra DAs — filtered by Haversine at line 637

break_it.scenario: ThreadPoolExecutor exception in _fetch_db_data propagates to main thread
break_it.what_happens: db_future.result() re-raises the exception, report generation fails
break_it.how: _fetch_db_data has outer try/except returning safe defaults. All inner DB functions also catch Exception.
break_it.repro: Kill DB connection during report generation

break_it.scenario: DA table has NULL latitude/longitude for all rows
break_it.what_happens: fetch_nearby_das returns empty list, DA section shows no nearby DAs
break_it.how: conveyancing_db.py:637 — explicit None check skips rows without coords

break_it.scenario: Shadow and DB run in parallel but shadow modifies shared state
break_it.how: Shadow only reads controls (height). DB writes to separate return values. No shared mutable state between threads.

post_merge.other_repo: No — DA table already created and backfilled
post_merge.manual_verify: Run conveyancing report for Inner West address, confirm DAs appear
